summary: The machine-based post-processor's export2 pipeline now does modal-command and modal-axis deduplication and line numbering on Path.Command objects (new PathOptimizationUtils, _add_line_numbers hook, modal_barrier and no_collapse_g0 annotations) instead of on the stringified G-code, and the Processor no longer applies the FILTER_INEFFICIENT_MOVES machine output option.

pages.reason: Path/Post/Processor.py: STAGE 4 string-world _optimize_gcode removed; export2 now calls _optimize_duplicates_doubles (modal_gcode/modal_axis from PathOptimizationUtils) then _add_line_numbers after all expansions and before command conversion; _edit_command_list gains all_postables; subclasses must render the N parameter in _convert_move; FILTER_INEFFICIENT_MOVES no longer consulted; Constants.py adds ANNOT_MODAL_BARRIER and ANNOT_NO_COLLAPSE_G0 (collapse_g0 exists but _optimize_g0 is not wired into export2)

Path/Post/Processor.py: _optimize_gcode hunk drops filter_inefficient_moves so the FILTER_INEFFICIENT_MOVES output option has no effect; line numbering now numbers only Path.Commands per section, counts but does not number 'str' blocks, skips comments and preserves an existing N word

Constants.py: new annotation keys ANNOT_MODAL_BARRIER ('modal_barrier') and ANNOT_NO_COLLAPSE_G0 ('no_collapse_g0'), plus AXIS_MODAL/PARAMETER_MODAL/NOT_PARAMETER_MODAL; DrillCycleExpander.py now tags G0 retracts with no_collapse_g0

Path/Post/scripts/opensbp_post.py: line-number-required commands now get N=LINE_NUMBER_START in Path.Command world and OUTPUT_DUPLICATE_COMMANDS is forced on, but the previous _optimize_gcode override already disabled command dedup, so the documented ShopBot output and the Post Process dialog are unchanged

meta.title: CAM: mbpp optimizations & line-numbers in Path.Command world
